bump_rules.patch: +0.0.1  component-scoped change (one lib/<subsystem>.scad or one src/components/*.scad)
bump_rules.minor: +0.1.0  full-turtle-scoped change: src/Full_Turtle.scad, a world transform, the assembly_view dispatch, or a lib/params.scad value that moves a mating interface
bump_rules.major: +1.0.0  bottle / board / hardware interface break (existing builds no longer fit)

changelog.note: Baseline. Build/lint/test tooling added; regression baseline captured for all 27 renders (OpenSCAD 2021.01). No geometry change.

Shared-library refactor M1-M6. All 8 standalone components now generated from lib/ parametric modules + lib/params.scad (the shared dimension contract). Full_Turtle_v1.scad relocated to src/Full_Turtle.scad and is now a generated bundle (M1.5). Geometry changes to the standalones: TB-03 kept (cap 5 mm roof / 2 mm boss - was already in the committed cap); TB-04 applied (axle round section re-derived to the 5 mm roof -> overall length 58->59 mm, magnet recess retained); TB-07 applied (rear-fin green-slat mounting hole 50->103 mm, derived from the mating Ecojoiner John). Every standalone render matches its pre-refactor bounding box except the two documented above (see tests/expected_bounds.json notes). Full assembly (src/Full_Turtle.scad) NOT yet rewired to lib - M7 pending - so TB-01/02/03/04 are not yet applied there.

M7 partial. src/Full_Turtle.scad now uses lib/bottle_mockup.scad, lib/ecojoiner.scad, lib/ballast_fin.scad and lib/util.scad (wood_color + m6_bolt_placeholder); ~750 lines of embedded geometry removed and the ecojoiner_and_bottles / installed_ballast entry points rewired to the eco_* / bl_* lib API. All three assembly_view renders (full_turtle, top_sail, core) still match tests/expected_bounds.json exactly - NO geometry change, so no baseline update. Still embedded: the rear-fin part modules (deferred - visible solar panel + fasteners not in lib/rear_fin.scad) and the whole hope_turtle_sail_apparatus control head (cap + axle + cage + frame). TB-01/02/03/04 still not applied to the full assembly - see CLAUDE.md section 15 step B.

M7 sail frame + cut bottle. The full turtle's sail wooden frame now comes from lib/sail_frame.scad (new part='native_assembly' -> sail_frame_native_group(), placed by a single positioned_sail_frame() with the same install transform the deleted positioned_* modules used), and its cut control bottle from a new lib/bottle_mockup.scad cut_bottle() (+ p_bottle_cut_height/p_bottle_cut_extra). ~810 more embedded lines removed (24 frame modules + the buzdagi bottle + its dome fns). This lands TB-01 (no non-sail-batten bottom bores, no C-piece M6 bores) and TB-02 (brown bottom rails) in the full assembly - bounds unchanged (internal bores + colour), so all three full_turtle views and all 8 sail_apparatus renders still match the baseline; no baseline update. STILL EMBEDDED: the control head cap + axle + cage (control_cap, turtle_control_axle, positioned_cage_assembly and the cage_* modules) - TB-03/TB-04 land when those move to lib/control_cap + lib/hex_shaft + lib/control_cage (CLAUDE.md 15.B). Rear fin still deferred (15.A).

M7 rear fin. The full turtle's rear-fin WOODEN parts (yellow fin, two green shafts, red holder) now come from lib/rear_fin.scad via a renamed full_rear_fin_assembly(); the visible solid solar panel + M3 screws stay embedded (lib/rear_fin.scad only carries a %-reference panel). The solar_panel_width/height/thickness globals now reference p_solar_panel_w/h/t() (still 148/223/2.5). Every derived rear-fin value (fin polygon, both joint slots, solar notch, shaft, holder) was checked equal to lib/rear_fin.scad beforehand; all three full_turtle views still match the baseline exactly - no baseline update. Only the control head (cap + axle + cage) remains embedded - see CLAUDE.md 15.B.

M7 COMPLETE - control head cap + axle + cage now from lib/. (a) control_cap -> lib/control_cap.scad: TB-03 applied to the full assembly (roof 8->5 mm, + 2 mm boss, twin 2x2 mm grooves replace the single 13x1.1). top_disk_thickness = p_cap_roof_t(); control_assembly_z = bottle_cut_height - top_disk_thickness unchanged, so the whole control head + sail frame drop 3 mm -> full_turtle & top_sail Z-max 309.5 -> 306.5 (only axis that moved; core unchanged). Baseline updated with a note. (b) turtle_control_axle -> lib/hex_shaft.scad control_axle(): TB-04 (59 mm + Ø3x1 magnet recess). Placed at control_assembly_z - (p_axle_hex_len()+p_axle_round_ext()) to align lib's hex-bottom origin with the cap face; geometry proven identical to the embedded axle after that shift, magnet recess is internal -> bounds unchanged. (c) cage_* build + positioned_cage_assembly -> lib/control_cage.scad: the embedded cage-native frame put bearing tips at Z=cage_bearing_tip_native_z (39.5); lib puts them at Z=0, so positioned_cage_assembly drops the '+ cage_bearing_tip_native_z' term. button_angle=cage_button_angle(0) + the 90-deg install rotate nets to 90 as before. Bounds unchanged. src/Full_Turtle.scad 4656 -> 2749 lines. Every subsystem in the full turtle now flows from lib/. TB-01/02/03/04/07 all applied to the full assembly. Remaining: physical/interface checks only (CH-2, TB-08) + external generators (TB-06) + an STL release (TB-05 residual).

Cage roof-top bevel (workflow test). New p_cage_roof_bevel() = 4 mm: a 45-deg OUTWARD chamfer on the roof-top outer edge, masked away within (notch_w/2 + bevel) of each batten groove so the groove walls stay square. Printable roof-face-down (radius only grows from the bed up). Bounding box unchanged on every render (control_cage__print/upright and all 3 full_turtle views) - the wedge is internal to the Oe115 x 70 envelope; only tris change. control_cage + full_turtle re-baselined to refresh tris; no dimensional change. All 9 bundles regenerated (p_cage_roof_bevel added to params.scad cascades to every inline). Added a FABRICATION note to lib/control_cage.scad, the cage wrapper header and CLAUDE.md s6/s16: the cage prints ROOF-FACE-DOWN and roof-top changes must stay self-supporting in that pose or be flagged.

Axle rotary-seal O-ring + its mold. (a) control_cap: new oring_gland (default on) - an annular groove in the axle bore (Oe11.5 root x 2.6 wide, centred 3.5 mm below the outer face) that seats a round-section O-ring against the spinning axle round section, waterproofing the 0.3 mm bore gap. Internal to the Oe100 x 40 envelope -> cap + full_turtle bounds unchanged; only tris. Asserts guard gland-OD vs bore/boss wall and groove+lands vs the 7 mm bore column. (b) lib/silicone_ring_mold.scad: added the axle O-ring (round torus, ID = p_axle_round_d() = 8, CS 2, OD 12) and a TWO-PART PRESSED mold for it - part=oring_bottom / oring_top (print flat, half-torus channel up), oring_pair (exploded view), oring (cast torus), all (flat + O-ring molds laid out). 3 male pegs on the bottom half seat in 3 female holes in the top half so the halves stay aligned when pressed; fill + vent through the top half. oring_mold_half() asserts the pegs stay inside the plate. part=mold / rings unchanged (190 x 91 x 4.5) - backward compatible. New params p_axle_oring_* / p_cap_oring_gland_*. manifest.json gains 4 mold renders (oring_bottom/oring_top export STLs). No dimensional change on any existing render; control_cap + silicone_ring_mold + full_turtle re-baselined to record the new renders + refreshed tris. CLAUDE.md s7 (O-ring gland) + s8 (two-part O-ring mold) updated.

(a) Silicone ring mold restructured into ONE two-part pressed mold that casts the flat insert-seal ring(s) AND the axle O-ring in a single session. The O-ring is nested in the centre of the first flat-ring mold ('an additional mold circle'); its torus is split across the two plates. 3 male pegs (bottom plate, 8 mm rim) seat in 3 female holes (top plate); O-ring fill+vent through the top plate. New part values: mold (exploded inspection, no longer a printable STL), mold_bottom / mold_top (the printable plates, 210 x 101; export_stl), rings, oring. The 1.6.0 standalone oring_bottom/oring_top/oring_pair parts and their STLs are removed - folded in. O-ring ID stays tied to p_axle_round_d() (8) - the sealing round section of the hex-shaft axle. manifest.json + baseline updated (silicone_ring_mold now 5 renders; 3 dead oring_* keys pruned). (b) File renames for naming consistency (versioning lives in VERSION.json): Turtle_Rear_Fin_v2.scad -> Turtle_Rear_Fin_v1.scad, Turtle_Sail_Apparatus.scad -> Turtle_Sail_Apparatus_v1.scad (src wrappers + v1.0 SCADs bundles + manifest + a lib/sail_frame comment + the rear-fin header line). No geometry change - rear_fin and sail_apparatus renders unchanged. CLAUDE.md s3/s8 updated.

Silicone mold: (a) part=mold is now the PRINTABLE layout - both plates laid flat and side by side (top plate flipped, working faces up) instead of the exploded face-to-face stack, so the single exported STL prints both halves in one no-support job. manifest.json marks mold export_stl (stl name Silicone_Ring_Mold); mold_bottom / mold_top kept for printing a plate at a time. mold bounds 210x101x18.5 -> 210x222x8.5. (b) An axle O-ring is now nested in the centre of EVERY flat-ring mold (was only the first), so the default 2-ring mold casts two O-rings = two chances at a good one; each gets its own half-torus split across the plates plus a fill+vent in the top plate. rings render gains the second torus; mold_bottom/mold_top/rings tris up. O-ring ID unchanged (p_axle_round_d() = 8). silicone_ring_mold re-baselined (intentional); no other subsystem touched.

Ecojoiner port length is now DERIVED: p_port_length() = p_top_dome_h() + new p_port_allowance() (62 + 20 = 82). It was the evaluated constant 82, which broke the rule for any bottle whose top taper differs from the reference bottle - the HopeTurtles.org generators already derive it as taper_height + port_allowance, and lib is the source of truth for the rule. Value unchanged at defaults, so no geometry, bounds or baseline move; every bundle regenerates because params.scad is inlined in all of them. Bridge to the generators documented in CLAUDE.md section 19.

Added a genuine cross-check assert for the rear-fin/Ecojoiner M6 mounting-hole alignment. The existing assert ("Rear-fin and John mounting-hole axes must coincide") only checked the X axis (hole_from_front) against a value DEFINED from the same terms it compares to, so it could never fail - it was not proof the shafts are actually flush against the John. Verified via rendered coordinate probes (real board geometry, not just formulas) that the current model IS already correctly aligned on the Y axis (the boards' stacking direction) - the two rear-fin shaft boards meet their target Little John boards flush, with zero gap, at Y=6 and Y=112. No placement values changed; geometry and bounds are unchanged (assert-only addition), confirmed via build/lint.py's OpenSCAD parse plus a manual numeric negative-control test showing the new assert's terms would diverge under a simulated 12mm regression.

Restored the Master John. One of the six Little Johns in the standalone Ecojoiner (eco_ecojoiner_only) is now the deeper-slotted piece fitted last: same outline, collar hole and M6 holes, but its two top slots are cut to eco_master_slot_depth() = min(floor(port_height/2), floor(john_height*0.6)) = 34 mm instead of the standard 29, so it can drop past the already-seated Johns of the almost-closed frame. Without the deeper slot the third rectangle cannot be assembled. The rule is lifted verbatim from the HopeTurtles.org 6FC generator (objects/ecojoiner_6fc.py::master_slot_depth), which had always carried it - this is a sanctioned upstream lift under CLAUDE.md s19 ('lib owns the rule'), reversing the 2026-09-08 v1.7.1 sync that had wrongly flattened it away. New: eco_master_slot_depth(), eco_master_john_2d(), eco_master_john(); eco_standing_little_john() gains is_master, eco_john_rectangle()/eco_centered_rectangle() gain master_first_john (appended last so the four positional callers in src/Full_Turtle.scad are untouched). Full-turtle assembly (ecojoiner_and_bottles) is byte-identical - it does not set the flag. Standalone bounds unchanged (min [0,-118,-206] / max [294,176,88], deeper slot is an internal cut); the pre-existing non-2-manifold WARNING is unchanged. build/test.py ecojoiner + build/baseline.py ecojoiner run: bounds unchanged, tri/echo baseline re-recorded (the prior baseline predated the lib/ refactor - see the tests/expected_bounds.json note). ALSO in this version (tooling, no geometry): build/export_params.py renders every lib/params.scad p_*() to build/params.json (126 values + version), hooked into build/build.py and gated by build/lint.py --check - it is the S-5 sync mechanism the HopeTurtles.org generators vendor and diff against (SYNC_PLAN.md S-5, CLAUDE.md s19).

Sails gain straight fold-over tabs at the top and bottom rail edges, for stapling the sail membrane to the rails - previously the sail polygon stopped exactly at the two rail lines with nothing to attach to. Each tab is a rectangular extension of the trapezoid's full edge width at that end (new local sail_tab_height, placeholder 50 mm for visual inspection; will eventually equal board_width so the tab folds flat onto the rail's stock thickness). The sail stays one flat 2D shape (a 6-point simple polygon) extruded to the same 0.1 mm thickness. Deliberately cuts straight out through the rail/batten wood at this placeholder height - no clash handling added, none requested. Component-scoped to lib/sail_frame.scad (no lib/params.scad or shared-signature change), so per CLAUDE.md s15 step 5 the cross-subsystem mesh regression (build/test.py) was not run, only build/lint.py (clean) plus visual inspection: rendered part="sails" and the full_turtle assembly_view="top_sail" in OpenSCAD with no new ERROR/WARNING; the sails render visibly shows the added tabs. Bounding boxes for sails/top_sail/full_turtle grow (tabs extend past the rails); tests/expected_bounds.json intentionally not touched - a baseline re-record is a maintainer call (build/baseline.py) since this was flagged as inspection-only, not a release.

Sail tab height changed from the 50 mm inspection placeholder (v1.8.2) to sail_tab_height = board_width (12 mm at reference params), so the fold-over tab no longer protrudes out the far face of the rail - it now folds flat onto the rail's stock thickness as originally intended. No other geometry change. Component-scoped to lib/sail_frame.scad; build/lint.py clean, part="sails" re-rendered visually to confirm the tab now stops within the rail thickness. Bounding boxes for sails/top_sail/full_turtle shrink back toward (but not exactly to) the pre-tab v1.8.1 baseline; tests/expected_bounds.json still intentionally untouched.
